# ctables/streq

> Helper: string equality, `__pk_streq(a, b)`: the lengths, then the bytes.

truck [ctables](../ctables.md) · [source](../../../registry/ctables/streq.pkg)

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm

```

## Support code (once per program)

```nasm
static W __pk_streq(W a, W b) {
W n = *(W *)a;
return n == *(W *)b && memcmp((char *)a + 8, (char *)b + 8, n) == 0;
}
```
